result:
Round 274 is implemented within the granted files. An arrow-key nudge now writes its own result to the status line, so the old "added …" or "Stopped — …" text no longer stays behind. C still has to verify it in the browser; SYS-6 is not marked done.

**What changed** (8 files modified, 1 new doc; no commit):
- **Source:** `nudgeSelectedClip` in `ArrangementContext.tsx` and a new `studioMoveStrings.nudged` text.
  - **Single clip:** writes `Nudge clip: start <t>.`, using the start where the clip actually landed.
  - **Group:** reuses the existing drag texts, for example `Move (2): 2 clips moved 00:01.000 to the right.`
  - **Held key:** a single clip announces each new start. A group announces once per press, not again while the key is held.
  - Refusal texts, the deps array and every other function are unchanged.
- **Tests:**
  - SK7 and NZ3 now expect the exact 4-text lists: three nudge results, then the refusal once. No assertion was removed.
  - New tests: SK13–SK15, LT20, LT21. Two describe titles renamed as granted.
- **Docs:** line 4 of docs 203 and 204 set to `Completed (C round 274 PASS)`. New doc 205 in Georgian with the template headings.

**One departure from B's test text, left for C to judge.** SK14 compares clip positions rounded to the millisecond. A group nudge adds up rounding error: the clip at 5 ends at `5.399999999999999` instead of 5.4. This already happens at HEAD, in `moveClips` in `selection.ts`, which is a frozen file. The status text is not affected because it rounds to ms. The text, announcement-count and span checks in SK14 are exact. I logged it for B as a new candidate finding, A-R274-GROUP-NUDGE-FLOAT-DRIFT.

**Checks I ran:**
- `npm run typecheck` passes. `npm run lint` passes with only existing warnings, and Biome on the 6 changed code and test files reports nothing.
- **Tests:** the 13 test files named in the task pass, 323/323. The frozen bars-ruler-ui and gesture-reentry pass, 39/39. The slowest test took 1844 ms against a 15 s limit (12%).
- **Mutants:** all 7 fail on the rows the task names, re-run on the final tree. The file was restored byte-identically.
- **Browser:** Chromium on :5173, both 1440×900 and 1280×720, 0 page errors. The single-clip, held-key, group-right and past-end nudge cases gave exactly the texts the task expects. My first attempt timed out waiting for the demo to load, apparently because the dev server was rebuilding after my edits; the re-run passed.
- **Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent found no Critical, High or Medium issues and had no architecture note. I fixed its Low points: the doc wording and LT21 now checking the exact stopped text before the nudge. Two Info notes go to B:
  - The group text is skipped if the first selected clip is missing from the arrangement. The reviewer found no way to reach this.
  - The rounding drift above.

**Left for C:**
- Browser rows I did not run: group then ArrowLeft, Undo, the blocked nudge, Space and Stop after the past-end case, the audio check, Enter twice, text width, screen budget and the auth check.
- Gate rows: full test suite, build, full Biome, verify and e2e smoke.

My report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-274.md`. Supporting files (mutant script and results, browser probe output and screenshots) are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-274/`.
